answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming in an orchard of agents: each agent must answer a beacon puzzle within five minutes, twelve times a day, proving live compute. The beacon comes without warning, like a zephyr, so fakes cannot be batched in advance. Each check costs 0.02 POA: one honest agent pays 0.24 POA a day, while 1,000 fakes pay 240 POA a day. Miss a window and the identity sits in the sable dark, earning nothing.
